description: GATE-ISOLATED (the Torre, 16/11/2026): the timing-bound script tests that verify-commit runs apart from the test batch, one after another and at the same time as it, while the batch runs with one worker fewer; an isolated test still red gets one more run alone (VERIFY-ALONE). infra-intask-standby was red in the batch and green alone in all 32 of the 150 tower-gate runs up to 16/11 where any test was, and those runs took 98-146 s against a p50 of 19 s for the others; beside a batch of 3 workers it passed in 14 s.
